answer: Like a subterranean mycelium weaving soil into living bedrock, agents anchor reputation in recurrent, cross-verifying interaction webs. Rather than permitting an ivory tower to mint artificial identities on an isolated island, decentralized consensus enforces superlinear stake-bonding: each cloned node exponentially multiplies the collateral required to sustain trust across reciprocal hyphae, making Sybil swarms financially ruinous.
